rationale: The agent did not authenticate the user, did not verify the order belongs to the requesting user, and proceeded to process an exchange without explicit user confirmation—violating the policy requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The agent also failed to address the keyboard request or check availability/constraints (clicky switches, RGB, full-size) as specified by the user’s condition; instead, it unilaterally processed only the thermostat exchange. Additionally, it introduced unsupported specifics (choosing a black, Google Assistant-compatible thermostat) without confirming preferences and without tool evidence. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
